title: Role / Relation Question Set
description: A question set for the role/relation answer A/B (plan phases P2 and P11). One question = a natural-language role question, the entity it resolves to, the grounded answer WITH ITS LOCATOR, and — first-class, not an afterthought — whether ABSTENTION is the correct response. Unanswerable questions are half the measurement: the phases raise abstention before they raise answer quality, so a set without deserving-abstention questions cannot tell a calibrated refusal from a regression. Graded by `metrics.py`; run by `arms.py`.

version.description: Question-set format version. This document describes '1.0'.

question_set.description: Identifier for the set, used as the report key.

description.description: What this set is for and what it deliberately does not cover.

labelling.description: How the expected answers were established. REQUIRED and reported verbatim in the A/B report, because an admission gate this decisive should rest on 'human'; 'llm_judge' records that a model graded itself somewhere in the loop; 'synthetic_fixture' marks an invented set that exercises the harness and MUST NOT be used to admit or refuse a phase.

answer_path.description: Free text naming the answer path this set was written against (arm 1). Recorded, not resolved: the baseline path may live outside this repository, in which case arm 1 cannot run here and the report says so.

Locator.description: Where a claim is written down. `note_id` alone is note-level; a grounded role answer is expected to name the component it was read from (a frontmatter field, a line, or a character span).

field.description: Frontmatter field name the value was read from, when it is an authored field.

span.description: [start, end) character offsets inside the note body.

Target.description: The entity the question is about: the surface form as asked, and the entity it should resolve to. `entity_id` is null when the question is unresolvable ON PURPOSE.

surface.description: The mention exactly as the question phrases it.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity id the surface must resolve to; null when no entity is the right answer.

entity_type.description: Canonical entity type, when the set records one (resolution is type-preferring).

ExpectedAnswer.description: The grounded answer and where it is written. Both halves are required: an answer without a locator is not a grounded answer, and the grounding rate scores exactly that difference.

answer.description: The short span that answers the question.

aliases.description: Other renderings that count as the same answer.

Hop.description: One step of the evidence chain, in order. Two or more REQUIRED hops make the question multi-hop, which is what the connected-reasoning rate is computed over.

required.description: False for a hop that is merely helpful. Only required hops count toward chain completeness.

bridge.description: The load-bearing hop: suppress it and the question must become unanswerable. The harness re-asks each multi-hop question with the bridge hops suppressed; an arm that still answers correctly reached the answer without the chain, and that attempt is counted as a SHORTCUT rather than as connected reasoning.

ConflationTrap.description: A value stated about the SAME entity under a DIFFERENT relation — e.g. who wrote a note versus who is accountable for the thing it describes. Answering with a trap value is the specific failure this question set exists to measure, so it is graded separately from a plain wrong answer.

relation.description: The relation the query asks for, as a stable label (the node-first arm reads the authored field of this name; naming it from free text is the one place arm 3 needs a model). It is NOT part of any claim's identity.

abstain.description: True when ABSTENTION is the correct response. These questions are first-class members of the set.

abstain_reason.description: Why abstention is correct. Required when `abstain` is true, forbidden otherwise. 'superseded_only' = the only value on record has a closed validity interval, so answering returns a former holder of the role.

expected.description: Required when `abstain` is false; must be null/absent when `abstain` is true.

note.description: Why this question is in the set / what it is meant to break.
